host_clock_observation.initial_gap_note: Observer started before P01 readiness and solver dispatch. Do not interpret civil elapsed time as proof/model compute time.

operational_incidents.description: Solver reported FileNotFoundError from mistyped workspace component in --response path. No verification ran and no proposal was consumed. Corrected the command path using the same existing response; no proof, budget, timeout, or verification retry was authorized.

limitations: These strategies have evidence on other development problems; P01 was used to derive B2/B3 hypotheses; this is an in-development-problem replication, not a held-out generalization test.
The observed free-search session is not a controlled Astra-versus-other-model comparison.
Exact Codex model sampling seed, hidden system context, model calls and cost are not observable with the manual subagent adapter.
Two repetitions are exploratory; do not claim statistical significance or general policy superiority.
